name: Overlap: existing match regex catches new q
spec_quote: the other entry catches the new entry's `q` ("catches it")

name: Overlap: new match regex catches existing q
spec_quote: the new entry catches the other entry's `q` ("it catches")

name: Overlap: multiple existing catches plus new catches another

table.q: Please provide the name of the high school you currently attend

new.q: Please provide the name of the high school you currently attend and graduation year

spec_quote: Before a new entry is saved, it is placed at the end of the table (it is the newest) and checked against every other entry: - the other entry catches the new entry's `q` ("catches it"), or - the new entry catches the other entry's `q` ("it catches"). Any such other entry → the save stops, nothing is written, and those entries are named by number.

name: Overlap: clean table blocks nothing
spec_quote: Any such other entry → the save stops, nothing is written, and those entries are named by number.

name: Answer: newest pick regex chooses option
spec_quote: Every entry that catches the field's label is tried, newest first. For a field with options: the first `pick` regex that matches an option (trimmed) chooses it

name: Answer: newest catching entry misses, older ok answers
spec_quote: The first entry giving "ok" is the answer. If no entry gives "ok", the answer is the miss of the NEWEST catching entry.

name: Answer: all catching entries miss, newest miss rule returned
spec_quote: If no entry gives "ok", the answer is the miss of the NEWEST catching entry.

name: Answer: no entry catches label
spec_quote: No entry catches the label → no answer (null).

name: Answer: pattern-only text misses on text field, older plain words answer wins
spec_quote: On a field WITHOUT options such an entry gives a miss (status "unknown"), never the pattern as the answer — so an older catching entry with a plain text or yes answer may still answer. An entry whose `text` is plain words (pick "/^University of Chicago$/i" with text "University of Chicago") still answers a text field with its text.

name: Answer: yes false chooses No option
spec_quote: else for a `yes` entry the option meaning Yes / No

name: Answer: yes true on single-option checkbox chooses that option
spec_quote: else (yes = true, a checkbox with exactly one option) that option

name: Answer: normalisation removes required and star, maps curly apostrophe
spec_quote: its normalised `q` equals the normalised label. Normalising: lower case; curly apostrophes → '; the word "required" (optionally in parentheses) and "*" removed; every run of characters other than a-z, 0-9 and ' becomes one space; trimmed.
